fields.description: Secret token that authorizes completing this request via the guest account-setup form. Embedded in the invite link; for self-signups it is only released after the emailed verification code is confirmed.
fields.label: Request Key

fields.description: Alternate email that receives the invite link or the signup verification code; saved on the created account's settings and used for password resets.
fields.label: Backup Email

fields.description: The Suite Admin or System Manager who created this request. Empty for self-signup requests.
fields.label: Invited By

fields.description: Set when the request is completed: ownership of the backup email proven via the invite link or signup code, or force-verified by an admin creating the account directly.
fields.label: Is Verified

fields.description: Whether the request has passed its expiry time. Computed at read time.
fields.label: Is Expired

fields.description: The email address of the mail account to create; becomes the Frappe User and the Stalwart account's primary address.
fields.label: Account Email

fields.description: Additional email addresses (one per line) added as aliases to the account.
fields.label: Aliases

fields.description: Disk quota in GB applied to the account on creation, where 0 means unlimited. Left blank, the configured default disk quota is used.
fields.label: Disk Quota (GB)

fields.description: Stalwart group ids (one per line) the account is added to on creation.
fields.label: Groups

fields.description: Stalwart mailing list ids (one per line) the account's primary address is added to as a recipient on creation.
fields.label: Mailing Lists

fields.description: If enabled, an invite link is emailed to the backup email when the request is created. Left off, an admin-created account is provisioned immediately, while a self-signup proceeds by verifying an emailed code.
fields.label: Send Invite

fields.description: IP address the request was created from.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: When this request stops being valid and can no longer create an account. Defaults to one day after creation.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Stalwart roles (one per line) assigned to the account on creation. Left blank, defaults to User.
fields.label: Stalwart Roles

fields.description: If enabled, the created user gets the Suite Admin role in Frappe.
fields.label: Is Admin
